content: Lasaras gongwo ha
Ena Betani oo malgi hong yal ta haang Lasaras nibil ongwi. Ena Betani oo malgi iwe, al Maria abimbi al Mata oo malgi dungwi.
Ena al Maria iwe, Yisas kebering bani wel santa garu di bil tere breng eme ire kli sungwo al mongwi. Al iwe, keunimbi Lasaras nibil ongwi.
Ongure al suri yal ta bai nu si Yisas mongwo olere, “Yal Yisas ye, nin enin ta Lasaras irai nibil omua, ditenana po,” ditongwi.
Dungwo ha i Yisas pirere yu dungwi, “Nibil pangwo han dingi gonamo? Ta golkinamia. Nibil ongwo i God haang a yuwo olama dire omia. Olangwo meri, God Wang na ere para hana a yuwo olamua,” dungwi.
Ena Yisas al Mata ire, ebering ire, keunimbi Lasaras ire dire, yong miling tongwi.
Tere “Lasaras nibil omua” dungwo ha i pirere mongwo bani ari haung sutani ya mongwi.
Molere emgi Yisas na gamnahobi yu di na tongwi, “Ere Yudia namna pano.”
Dimba na gamnahobi yu ditomingi, “Tisao, naminba, Yudia ari hobi hulu ni sirala dimia. Ni hol i hon nala di dino?” dimingi.

Diminba Yisas yu di na tongwi, “Ari haung taniga honmil obil tamo? I ta takimia. Honmil omare pudungwo para tamia. Tangure yal ta hamen tare au dikinangure hol ware hogal sinamo? Au dungwo han kun ole wamia.
Hamen girungwo hol wangwiwe, au dungwo hane wamo? Ta hane wakimia. Hogal simua.”
Direre Yisas ha hon aine yu di na tongwi, “Na enan ta Lasaras haya ul pamia. Na pire hon uling yuralga airamua.”
Dungure na gamnahobi yu ditomingi, “Yal Yisas ye, Lasaras ul panangwo nibil wai sinamia aire ya monamua.”
Diminba, Yisas Lasaras gongwo hanere ha saa tere dimba, na yalhobi ha weni dima di pire bol yare memini pir po sikimingi.
Pir po sikimingere Yisas di ba bolere, yu di na tongwi, “Lasaras haya gomia.
Na ni yalhobi wa di piriga yon horega onangure ogolo pir na tenana di pire na pi yali kina molkiga wai piriwa. Yal i pai mongwo bani namna pano.”
Yisas gamahobi kwal gir kul engwo tal iwe, yu kul engwo yal ta haang Tomas mole na gamnahobo tau yu di na tongwi, “Nan para naminga i, gonaminga uminia pano,” dungwi.
Yisas “Airangwo ya, te mol pai iwe, hong bling memini na moliwa,” dungwo ha
Ena Yisas na gina kina pi malgi pa dimingi. Pa dire hamingere Lasaras ari yulagi engwo bani man wu emia, hamen haung sui sui dire pai mongwo hamingi.
Ena Betani malgi iwe, Yerusalem mala weni dungwi.
Dungure Yerusalem ari yal al hobi ure, hai mere, al Maria Mata kina keunimbi gomia yong aura di te mongwi.
Mongure al Mata Yisas umua dungwo pungwi. Pirere pi bangi pire uminga hangwi. Ena al Maria oo malgi ami di mongwi.
Ena al Mata Yisas yu ditongwi, “Yal Yisas ye, ni timiya ya mona, na keunambi golkinangwo dimba.
God sirin bol tenanga tal ta ni tenama di piriwa.”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni keunbi iwe, si hon ere airamua.”
Dungure al Mata yu dungwi, “Habang kul ere ganba wai sinangwo gin iwe, ari para weni airangwo gin i airama di piriwa.”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Airangwo ya, te mol pai iwe, hong bling memini na molia. Yal ta na grana wine ole moli pire gonangiwe, golere mol pai wai inanua.
Te yal ta hon molere na pir na tere grana wine ol i nanga yal i, golala di pinanba, ta golkire ya mol pananga bani pananua. Ni ha i nomani si pin mo pirikine?”
Dungure al Mata yu ditongwi, “Piminia. Ni singaba Kraist God Wang ya ganba bania unga na nomani si pir ni teiwa,” dungwi.
Yisas hai mengwo ha
Ena al Mata ha i di pisolere ere memini pire ebering al Maria gala di nin bangi ere yu ditongwi, “Tisa haya u molere ni sirin bomua.”
Dungure al Maria pi bangi pire Yisas na gina kina uminga na hangwi.
Yisas Mata di tongwo bani ya mol pare olo hungure Maria ure hangwi.

Hangure Yuda ari hobi oo ala molere, Maria yong aura di te mongwo hobi Maria aire gintani omia hanere doling bol ongwi. Pirere yu nomani si pungwi, Maria ari yulagi engwo bani pire hai merala dire oma di hangwi.
Ena al Maria Yisas na gina kina mominga bani u pa dire hangwi. Hanere ya habilai sire yu ditongwi, “Yal Yisas ye, ni timiya mona, keunambi golkinangwo dimba.”
Dire hai mengure Yuda ari hobi para hai howa dire memia Yisas hangwi. Hanere miling pirere miling gul sungwi.
Sirere, “Makena man wu ene?” dungwi. “Yal Yisas ye, eminga dima hanana wo,” dungwi.
Dungure Yisas hai mengwi.
Mengure Yuda ari hobi yu dungwi, “Yal i gongwo yal i yong miling tomia hano.”
Dimba tau yu dungwi, “Yal iwe, ari omeling gi dungwo a pila di tongwo yal momo? Monangwo Lasaras aki di tenangure golkinangwo pamba,” dungwi.
Lasaras haya gongwo bani Yisas uleng yungure airungwo ha
Ena Yisas miling gul go sungure na gina kina ere yulagi engwo bani omingi. Engwo bani iwe, hulu grang bir weni dungure hulu ta kwaling pera di engwi.

Engure Yisas hanere, “Hulu a krigi si mena olo,” dungwi. Dimba gongwo yal i keunimbi al Mata yu ditongwi, “Yal Yisas ye, yal iwe, hamen haya gongwo eminga hamen haung sui sui dire pai momia. Haya bil yare kunung unamua.”
Dimba Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni na onangwo pamia dire ogolo pir na tenanga, God yulang hananua, di ni tekimno?”
Dungure ari hobi hulu i mena olungwi. Olungure Yisas han gala dire yu dungwi, “Nabe, na ha diga pir mongi wai piria.
Habang habang na ha di ni tega pir monga bani monia. Ari yal al tabin mala mongwo hobi hanere, God bai nu sungure umia, di pinama dire di ni teiwa.”
Yu ditere gala dire, “Lasaras ni maini wo,” ditongwi.

Ditongure gongwo yal i aire maini ungwi. Maini umia kebering aling bani iwe, banisi han dale tongwi. Tere grang gumang bani para gal yobile han dale tongwi. Tongure Yisas hanere, “Han i gule ole to. Tengere hol wanamua,” ditongwi.
Isrel singaba hobi kene ongwo hobi kina Yisas si golala dire ha hongwo ha
Ena Yuda ari tau Maria hol ire ungwo hobi iwe, tal ongwo i hanere Yisas pir tongwi.
Tomba tau ere pi Perisi yalhobi mongwo bani pire Yisas tal ongwo ha i boling kul tongwi.
Tongure Perisi yalhobi pirere, ha maing oo singaba mongwo bani pire Yuda ari Kaunsil hobi gala di ku bole yu ditongwi, “Yal i tal guma hon dongwo miki omia, nan tal ol tenamne?

Nan han uning si olimingere, yal i tal yu ol monangwo, ari hobi para pir tere grang wine ole doling bonamia. Bonangure yol Roman kene ol na tongwo yalhobi hanere ha maing bling mining oo si gale nan na i susu olamua.”
Ena ari mongwo sina i yal ta Kaiapas ha maing singaba nambawan molere yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi maing ogolo hanere, pir po sikinia.
Nan Yuda para weni gonaminga, wai ta paikinamia. Te yal taniga gonangwo i ari para weni breng ol inamia. Ol inangwo i, wai panamua.”
Ha iwe yal i nin nomani si pungwo meri pire ta dikimia. Yal i me erin taniga ha maing oo singaba president mongwi. Molere yu dungwi, “Yisas golere Yuda ari hobi para weni breng sinamua.
Yisas gonangure Yuda ari hobi tani taman. God ari nu ke tongwo mol i nangwo hobi breng sinangure u tabin tani sinamua,” dire, awa ha di tibi olungwi.
Dungwo gin iwe, Yisas kara si golala dire erin mole ha hol mongwi.
Momia Yisas Yudia ganba bani hon ta gumang tekima, mena holo holi kul si ware mongwi. Molere Epraim oo malgi pi mongwi. Mongure na gamahobi kina ereho momingi.

Ena God Isrel arihobi han uning sungwo Pasoba erin haung u mala ongwi. Ongure ari ganba bina holo holi miki weni mo Yerusalem pire, Yudari memini pangwo meri wine ole talime pring i ole na tenama di pire God hau si ke tongwi.
Yu ol molere Yisas wa du i ongwi. Wa du i pire ha maing oo ala mole yalhobi nin diriyala ole yu dungwi, “Yal i erin habang i Yerusalem unama di pin mo, hunama di pine?”
Ena ha maing oo singaba hobi ire, Perisi ire dire, ha hol molere yu ditongwi, “Yisas monangwo hananga, bani momua di na to.” Dire han honama dire yu ditongwi.
